name: extreme-poverty
title: Extreme Poverty: People Living on Less Than $3 a Day (World Bank PIP)
description: Global, regional and country poverty estimates from the World Bank Poverty and Inequality Platform (PIP), September 2026 release, in 2021 purchasing power parity (PPP) dollars. Share and number of people living below the international (extreme) poverty line of $3.00 a day, and below the higher $4.20 and $8.30 lines, for the world and its regions every year from 1981 to 2026 (2025 and 2026 are nowcasts), plus country estimates for every household survey year. A frozen snapshot taken on 2026-11-22.

resources.name: aggregates
resources.title: World and regional poverty by year and poverty line, 1981 to 2026

fields.name: region_code
fields.description: World Bank code: WLD (world), the seven World Bank regions (EAS, ECS, LCN, MEA, NAC, SAS, SSF), and AFE and AFW, the eastern-southern and western-central halves of Sub-Saharan Africa.

fields.name: region_name
fields.description: Region name as given by PIP.

fields.name: region_type
fields.description: world, region or subregion. The seven regions add up to the world; AFE and AFW split SSF, so do not add them to the regions.

fields.name: year
fields.description: Reference year of the estimate.

fields.name: poverty_line
fields.description: Poverty line in 2021 PPP dollars per person per day: 3 (international or extreme poverty line), 4.2 (lower-middle-income line) or 8.3 (upper-middle-income line).

fields.name: headcount_ratio
fields.description: Share of the population (0 to 1) living in households whose income or consumption per person is below the poverty line.

fields.name: pop_in_poverty
fields.description: Number of people below the poverty line.

fields.name: population
fields.description: Population of the region in that year.

fields.name: poverty_gap
fields.description: Poverty gap index (0 to 1): average shortfall below the line, as a share of the line, counting the non-poor as zero.

fields.name: mean
fields.description: Mean daily income or consumption per person, 2021 PPP dollars.

fields.name: estimate_type
fields.description: PIP's label: actual (lined-up estimate with enough survey coverage), projection (survey coverage of the region is thin around that year, so the figure rests mostly on extrapolation) or nowcast (2025 and 2026, model-based beyond the latest survey data).

resources.name: country-surveys
resources.title: Country poverty in each household survey year, by poverty line

fields.name: country_code
fields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code (XKX for Kosovo).

fields.name: country_name
fields.description: Country or economy name as given by PIP.

fields.name: region_code
fields.description: World Bank region code (see aggregates).

fields.name: year
fields.description: Reporting year of the survey estimate.

fields.name: survey_year
fields.description: Survey year with decimals giving the mid-point of fieldwork when it spans two calendar years (e.g. 2022.58).

fields.name: reporting_level
fields.description: national, urban or rural. Some countries report urban and rural separately (and some surveys cover only urban areas).

fields.name: welfare_type
fields.description: consumption or income. Income-based and consumption-based poverty rates are not directly comparable.

fields.name: poverty_line
fields.description: Poverty line in 2021 PPP dollars per person per day: 3, 4.2 or 8.3.

fields.name: headcount_ratio
fields.description: Share of the population (0 to 1) below the poverty line.

fields.name: poverty_gap
fields.description: Poverty gap index (0 to 1).

fields.name: mean
fields.description: Mean daily income or consumption per person from the survey, 2021 PPP dollars.

fields.name: median
fields.description: Median daily income or consumption per person from the survey, 2021 PPP dollars.

fields.name: gini
fields.description: Gini index of the welfare distribution (0 to 1). Does not depend on the poverty line.

fields.name: population
fields.description: Population covered by the reporting level in the reporting year.

fields.name: survey_acronym
fields.description: Acronym of the household survey.

fields.name: survey_coverage
fields.description: Geographic coverage of the survey (national, urban or rural).

fields.name: distribution_type
fields.description: Data PIP used: micro (unit-record data), group (grouped data), imputed or synthetic.

fields.name: survey_comparability
fields.description: Comparability code within a country: estimates with the same code are comparable over time; a change marks a break (new survey design, questionnaire or welfare measure).
